name: correspondence-api

dependencies.name: aws-s3
dependencies.description: Generates presigned URLs for scanned copies and response attachments; files never pass through this service.

dependencies.name: sms-service
dependencies.description: Sends assignment and overdue-alert SMS to the phone number on the user's Thunder profile.

dependencies.name: email-intake
dependencies.description: Retrieves incoming email correspondence from each configured mailbox and logs it automatically.

description: The single backend for correspondence tracking: intake (manual and email), routing, status updates, responses, closure, department/mailbox management, user onboarding, notifications, and the aggregate public SLA-performance data. Owns the correspondence, department, movement, response and notification records. Does not render any UI and does not itself hold mailbox credentials in the browser.
